# Innioasis Updater

> Innioasis Updater is the free, open-source tool for installing and restoring software on every Innioasis player (Y1, Y2, G1, G3, G5, R1, PR1) and every Timmkoo player (A5, Q5, Q3), running on Windows, macOS, and Linux. The site also hosts the Themes Gallery and plain-English guides for custom software projects such as Rockbox, Solar, JJ Launcher, Inniclassic, Y2Player, and Koensayr. Install flows always ask the user to pick the model first and to connect the powered-off player only when Updater prompts.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://innioasis.app/): Overview of Innioasis Updater, the software catalogue, videos, and quick-start cards.
- [Installation guide](https://innioasis.app/guide.html): Full Windows, macOS, and Linux setup plus the model-first install steps for Updater.
- [Software downloads](https://innioasis.app/firmware.html): Browse releases for every software project by model, with guided Updater routes and manual ZIP links.
- [Firmware list](https://innioasis.app/firmware-list.html): Every release as plain HTML — model, software, author, original download URL and portable packages for Windows, macOS and Linux. This is also the page Updater CE opens when the firmware archive is unreachable.
- [Software FAQ](https://innioasis.app/firmware-faq.html): "Which software is right for you?" — plain-English comparisons of every project and the restore path.
- [Rockbox guide](https://innioasis.app/rockbox.html): Installing Rockbox on the Y1 or Y2, themes, Type A and Type B notes, and returning to stock.
- [Troubleshooting](https://innioasis.app/troubleshooting.html): Where an install stops and how to fix it — model, cable, driver, permissions, and timing.
- [Drivers](https://innioasis.app/drivers.html): Windows MediaTek driver and Linux USB permissions.
- [Developer guide](https://innioasis.app/developers.html): How to develop a custom firmware from a base ROM and publish it to the Updater manifest.
- [Support](https://innioasis.app/support_devs.html): How to contribute, report issues, and support the projects.

## Install guides by computer

- [All install guides](https://innioasis.app/install/): every software and model combination on Windows, macOS and Linux, with platform setup, Updater CE steps and the stock restore path.
- [Windows install guides](https://innioasis.app/install/windows.html): MediaTek driver, SmartScreen and Updater CE setup for Windows.
- [macOS install guides](https://innioasis.app/install/mac.html): Gatekeeper approval, direct USB and Updater CE setup for Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.
- [Linux install guides](https://innioasis.app/install/linux.html): AppImage, libfuse2 and the MediaTek udev rule.
- [Rockbox on Y2 with a Mac](https://innioasis.app/install/rockbox-y2-mac.html): the macOS Rockbox-Y2 route.
- [Reborn (Y2Linux) on Y2 with Linux](https://innioasis.app/install/reborn-y2linux-y2-linux.html): installing y2reborn on a Linux computer.
- [JJ Launcher on Y1 with a Windows PC](https://innioasis.app/install/jj-launcher-y1-windows.html): the Windows JJ Launcher route.

## Install guides by software

- [Rockbox on Y1](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y1-software.html): Model-first Rockbox install tutorial for the Y1.
- [Rockbox on Y2](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y2-software.html): The separate Y2 Rockbox package and install route.
- [Original Software on Y1](https://innioasis.app/original-software-y1.html): Restore the Y1 stock software.
- [Original Software on Y2](https://innioasis.app/original-software-y2.html): Restore the Y2 stock software.
- [Solar on Y1](https://innioasis.app/solar-y1-software.html): Network-first software (Wi-Fi) for the Y1.
- [Solar on Y2](https://innioasis.app/solar-y2-software.html): Solar Y2 entry with Wi-Fi, GPS, and FM.
- [JJ Launcher on Y1](https://innioasis.app/jj-launcher-y1-software.html): Fast, wheel-friendly launcher for the Y1.
- [JJ Launcher on Y2](https://innioasis.app/jj-launcher-y2-software.html): JJ Launcher for the Y2.
- [Inniclassic on Y1](https://innioasis.app/inniclassic-y1-software.html) and [Inniclassic on Y2](https://innioasis.app/inniclassic-y2-software.html): iPod Classic-style interface, available on both models from the same maintained project.
- [Y2Player on Y2](https://innioasis.app/y2player-y2-software.html): Music-first home screen for the Y2.
- [Koensayr on Y1](https://innioasis.app/koensayr-y1-software.html): Koensayr patch for the stock Y1 software.

## Why-software pages

- [Why Rockbox](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-benefits.html): What Rockbox adds — tag database, gapless playback, EQ, and themes.
- [Why Solar](https://innioasis.app/solar-benefits.html): Streaming, Wi-Fi, podcasts, and stem playback.
- [Why JJ Launcher](https://innioasis.app/jj-launcher-benefits.html): Speed, hardware-key skipping, and wireless uploads.
- [Why Inniclassic](https://innioasis.app/inniclassic-benefits.html): iPod Classic tribute on the Y1 and Y2.
- [Why Y2Player](https://innioasis.app/y2player-benefits.html): Offline music-first interface for the Y2.
- [Why Koensayr](https://innioasis.app/koensayr-benefits.html): Improves the stock Y1 software with Artist-to-Album navigation and root.

## Rockbox-Y1 (Rockbox for Y1) and Rockbox-Y2

Rockbox is community firmware for Innioasis players. This site calls the Y1 build
Rockbox-Y1 (or "Rockbox for Y1") and the Y2 build Rockbox-Y2 (or "Rockbox for Y2").
Innioasis Updater CE always downloads firmware packages directly from the community
firmware developers themselves, and those developers are solely responsible for
listing their software releases in Updater CE.

- [Rockbox-Y1 hub](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y1/): Install, developer ROM downloads, themes, restore and troubleshooting for the Y1.
- [Install Rockbox-Y1](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y1/install.html): Step-by-step Updater CE install guide.
- [Rockbox-Y1 ROM download](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y1/download.html): Direct developer ROM packages for the Y1.
- [Rockbox for Y1](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-for-y1.html): Overview of Rockbox-Y1 on the Innioasis Y1.
- [Rockbox-Y1 tutorial](https://innioasis.app/guides/rockbox-y1.html): Full written installation walkthrough.
- [Rockbox-Y1 themes](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y1-themes.html): Theme installation, 240p and 360p builds.
- [Rockbox-Y2 hub](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y2/): Install, developer ROM downloads, themes, restore and troubleshooting for the Y2.
- [Install Rockbox-Y2](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y2/install.html): Step-by-step Updater CE install guide.
- [Rockbox-Y2 ROM download](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y2/download.html): Direct developer ROM packages for the Y2.
- [Rockbox for Y2](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-for-y2.html): Overview of Rockbox-Y2 on the Innioasis Y2.
- [Rockbox-Y2 tutorial](https://innioasis.app/guides/rockbox-y2.html): Full written installation walkthrough.
- [Rockbox-Y2 themes](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y2-themes.html): Theme installation, 240p and 360p builds.
- [Rockbox ROM download, both models](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-rom-download.html): Y1 and Y2 developer ROM packages side by side.
- [Rockbox-Y1 vs Rockbox-Y2](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y1-vs-y2.html): Hardware and build comparison.
